value.body: An MLOps engineer builds the systems that train, deploy, monitor and update machine learning models in production. Product companies, IT services firms and AI teams hire them. A day involves writing pipeline code, managing cloud infrastructure, setting up monitoring and working with data scientists.

items.label: Typical entry
items.value: B.Tech / MCA with software and ML basics

items.label: Common tools
items.value: Python, Docker, Kubernetes, CI/CD, cloud platforms, MLflow

items.label: Indian tech-sector workforce
items.note: Whole tech industry, not this role alone

items.label: IndiaAI Mission outlay
items.note: Approved for five years; includes shared GPU computing for AI work

value.title: How you get in
value.body: Few roles are titled MLOps at fresher level. Many people start as software, DevOps or data engineers and move into MLOps. Projects that deploy a model end to end, with containers and monitoring, help show the skill.

value.title: Skills you'll use
items: CI/CD pipelines for model training and release
Model monitoring, versioning and data drift checks

value.title: At a glance
items: The field is newer and job titles vary across companies.
Common next roles: senior MLOps or ML platform engineer, ML infrastructure lead.
Tools change quickly, so continual learning is part of the job.
